branch.description: The name of the branch to create the backup for.

completed_at.description: If the backup is completed, this is the timestamp of when it was completed.

created_at.description: The timestamp of when the backup object was created.

database.description: The name of the database to create the backup for.

expires_at.description: If the backup is completed, this is the timestamp of when it will expire.

organization.description: The organization where the backup will be created as well as the database/branch belong to.

public_id.description: The public ID of the backup.

started_at.description: The timestamp of when the backup started.

state.description: The state of the backup. Options are: 'pending', 'running', 'success', 'failed', 'canceled'.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for the backup.

block.description: A Planetscale backup. This resource will create a new backup for a database in your Planetscale organization. The backup will be created for the specified branch.

html_url.description: The URL of the database in the Planetscale web UI.

name.description: The name of the database. This must be unique within the organization.

notes.description: Notes about the database. These are only visible to you and other members of the organization.

organization.description: The organization where the database will be created.

region.description: The region where the database will be created. If not specified, the default region for the organization will be used. Currently, following regions are supported: ap-northeast, ap-south, ap-southeast, aws-ap-southeast-2, eu-central, eu-west, aws-eu-west-2, aws-sa-east-1, us-east, aws-us-east-2, us-west, gcp-us-central1, gcp-us-east4, gcp-northamerica-northeast1, gcp-asia-northeast3. For more information on regions, please see here: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/regions.

state.description: The state of the database. This will be one of the following: creating, ready, or error.

block.description: A Planetscale database. This resource will create a new database in your Planetscale organization.Once created, you can manage the database using the Planetscale web UI or the Planetscale CLI. For more information on Planetscale databases, please see here: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/planetscale-workflow.

backup_id.description: The ID of the backup to create the database branch from. If not specified, the database's default branch will be used.

database.description: The name of the database to create the branch for.

html_url.description: The URL to the database branch in the Planetscale UI.

name.description: The name of the database branch.

organization.description: The name of the organization to create the database branch in.

parent_branch.description: The name of the parent branch to create the database branch from. If not specified, the database's default branch will be used.

production.description: Whether the database branch is a production branch.

ready.description: Whether the database branch is ready to be used.

region.description: The region where the database will be created. If not specified, the default region for the organization will be used. Currently, following regions are supported: ap-northeast, ap-south, ap-southeast, aws-ap-southeast-2, eu-central, eu-west, aws-eu-west-2, aws-sa-east-1, us-east, aws-us-east-2, us-west, gcp-us-central1, gcp-us-east4, gcp-northamerica-northeast1, gcp-asia-northeast3. For more information on regions, please see here: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/regions.

seed_data.description: The name of the database branch to seed the new database branch with. If not specified, the database's default branch will be used.

block.description: A database branch resource. This resource allows you to create and manage database branches. A database branch is a copy of a database that can be used for development, testing, or other purposes.For more information on database branches please see here: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/branching.

name.description: The name of the database branch password.

plaintext.description: The plaintext password of the database branch password.

public_id.description: The public ID of the database branch password.

role.description: The role of the database branch password. Defaults to admin. Once a password is created, its role cannot be changed. Supported values: admin, reader, writer, readwriter.

username.description: The username of the database branch password.

block.description: The database branch password resource allows you to manage a database branch password in Planetscale. This resource is used to create, read, update, and delete database branch passwords. For more information on database branch passwords, see the Planetscale documentation at https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/connection-strings

approved.description: Whether the deploy request has been approved.

branch.description: The name of the branch to start the deploy request onto.

created_at.description: The time the deploy request was created.

deployment_state.description: The deployment state of the deploy request.

html_url.description: The URL of the deploy request.

id.description: The ID of the deploy request.

into_branch.description: The name of the branch to merge the deploy request into.

notes.description: The notes for the deploy request.

number.description: The number of the deploy request.

state.description: The state of the deploy request.

updated_at.description: The time the deploy request was last updated.

block.description: A Planetscale deploy request allows to create and revert non-blocking schema changes on a database branch. More info: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/deploy-requests

completed_at.description: If the backup is completed, this is the timestamp of when it was completed.

expires_at.description: If the backup is completed, this is the timestamp of when it will expire.

public_id.description: The public ID of the backup.

started_at.description: The timestamp of when the backup started.

state.description: The state of the backup. Options are: 'pending', 'running', 'success', 'failed', 'canceled'.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for the backup.

branch.description: The name of the branch to get the backups for.

database.description: The name of the database to get the backups for.

organization.description: The name of the organization that the backups belong to.

block.description: The backups data source provides information about the backups of a database/branch. For more information, see the official documentation on Backups and Restore here: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/back-up-and-restore

branch.description: The name of the branch that the passwords belong to.

database.description: The name of the database that the branch belongs to.

organization.description: The name of the organization that the database belongs to.

plaintext.description: The plaintext password for this password. This value is sensitive and will not be stored in the state file.

public_id.description: The public ID for this password.

passwords.description: A list of passwords for the database branch.

block.description: The database branch passwords data source provides a list of passwords for a database branch. At least one of organization, database or branch has to be provided for filtering. If you need to get a full list of passwords for all branches, you can filter by your organization name. For more information on database branch passwords, see here: https://planetscale.com/docs/concepts/connection-strings.

database.description: The name of the database to get the branches for.

access_host_url.description: The URL to access the database branch.

html_url.description: The URL to the database branch in the Planetscale UI.

name.description: The name of the database branch.

parent_branch.description: The name of the parent branch.

production.description: Whether the database branch is a production branch.

ready.description: Whether the database branch is ready to be used.

region.description: The region where the database branch is hosted.

organization.description: The name of the organization that the database belongs to.

html_url.description: URL to the database in the web UI.

organization.description: The name of the organization to list databases for.

block.description: List of databases in the organization. At this time, it is not possible to list databases of a specific region only.

number.description: The number of the deploy request to get.

organization.description: The name of the organization the database belongs to.

organization.description: The name of the organization to list regions for.

enabled.description: Whether the region is enabled or not.

location.description: The location of the region in humanized form.
